from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import formal

root = Path("runs/pendulum-formal-quick")
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
smv = root / "model.smv"
model = Path("sysml-models/rotary-inverted-pendulum/model.sysml").resolve()
subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(formal.EXTRACTOR), str(model), "--dt", "0.001", "-o", str(smv)], check=True)
source = smv.read_text()
names = {"Motor Voltage Within Authorized Range", "Controller Supplies State Feedback"}
selected = [o for o in formal._invariant_obligations(source) if o.name in names]
assert len(selected) == 2, [(o.name, o.kind) for o in selected]
nuxmv = Path.home() / "tools/nuxmv/2.2.0/nuxmv-2.2.0.sh"
results = [formal._run_obligation(o, source, root / f"{o.index:03d}-{formal._slug(o.name)}", nuxmv, 60) for o in selected]
print(json.dumps(results, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
if not all(r["status"] == "proved" for r in results):
    raise SystemExit(1)
